report.answer_text:
The last technical white Christmas in the UK was 2023, as far as I can find. The Met Office counts a white Christmas if a single snowflake is seen falling somewhere in the UK on 25 December. In 2023, 11% of stations recorded snow falling, although none reported any snow lying on the ground.[1] The sources I found don't break this down for England specifically, so I can't confirm that any of that snow fell there.
Widespread snow on the ground is much rarer. The last time was 2010, when 83% of stations reported snow on the ground, the highest percentage ever recorded.[2] Since 1960 that has happened only four times: 1981, 1995, 2009 and 2010.[2]
The sources I found were published before Christmas 2025, and 2023 was still listed as the latest white Christmas in them. I couldn't confirm what happened on Christmas Day 2025, so check the Met Office's White Christmas page for the latest record.
